description: WebToe POP OpSpecs -- auto-generated from TD data

operators.label: Accumulate POP
operators.description: Creates running sums (integrals) of attribute values. For each point, the output is the sum of all previous points' values. Two modes: Inclusive (includes current point) and Exclusive (excludes current point).

operators.label: Alembic In POP
operators.description: Loads and plays back Alembic (.abc) file geometry and multi-frame sequences. Supports polymesh (triangles/quads), curves, points, and Alembic transformations. New in 2025.3: Delayed load type, extended playback controls, linear interpolation for all point positions.

operators.label: Alembic Out POP
operators.description: New in TD 2025.3: Writes POP contents to Alembic .abc files. Supports multi-frame animation, built-in and custom attributes, and multiple POPs as separate Alembic objects in one file. Enables pipeline integration with Houdini, Maya, Blender, and other 3D software.

operators.label: Analyze POP
operators.description: Analyzes any point, vertex or primitive attributes of a POP and outputs a single point containing resulting statistics. Computes average, min, max, sum, size, index, centroid, RMS power, and more. Per-component analysis for vectors (e.g., Min(0) = min X). Supports Combine Components to reduce vectors to scalar before analysis.

operators.label: Attribute Combine POP

params.label: Duplicate Attributes
menu: Only Replace Attribs of First Input

operators.description: Takes multiple POP inputs and merges their attributes by name or pattern matching. For each input, select which attributes to include and optionally rename them. Handles duplicate attributes with auto-rename, keep first/last, or replace. Supports Point, Vertex, or Primitive attribute classes. Also handles length mismatches between inputs.

operators.label: Attribute Convert POP
operators.description: Copies attributes between attribute classes (Point <-> Vertex <-> Primitive). Can delete original and handle naming conflicts with ignore/warning/error modes.

operators.label: Attribute POP
Blend POP
operators.description: Blends together attributes across multiple input POPs. Simple types (average, add, multiply, min, max) and complex types (proportional, proportional smoothed) that mix based on per-input blend weights. Map page allows per-point override of blend weights from attributes.

operators.label: Box POP
operators.description: Creates 6-sided boxes with optional rounded corners, multiple texture mapping methods, and per-face color. Supports triangles, quads, or point primitives with vertex/point/primitive normals.

operators.label: Cache Blend POP
operators.description: Takes a reference to a Cache POP and outputs a blend of its cached data sets based on Cache Index and Cache Weight. Blend is per-point, useful for time-blurs and slope/speed calculation.

operators.label: Cache POP
operators.description: Receives POP data every frame and holds the most recent frames (up to Cache Size) in GPU memory. Outputs any held frame based on Output Index (time-delay). Cache Select and Cache Blend POPs can access combinations of held inputs for multi-frame blends.

operators.label: Cache Select POP
operators.description: Takes a reference to a Cache POP and outputs one cached data set based on Cache Index. Index 0 = current frame, -1 = previous cached data, and so on.

operators.label: CHOP to POP
operators.description: Converts CHOP channels to POP point attributes. Each CHOP sample becomes one POP point. Supports automatic channel-to-attribute mapping via naming conventions (compatible with POP to CHOP Precise format). Enables audio visualization, motion capture, and sensor data to flow into the POP pipeline.

operators.label: Circle POP
operators.description: GPU-accelerated circle geometry generator. Creates open arcs or closed circles as point primitives or line strips. Supports inner/outer radius for ring shapes, configurable divisions, and XY/YZ/ZX orientation planes.

operators.label: Connectivity POP
operators.description: Re-connects input points with new primitives. Works on multi-dimensional POPs (rows, columns, slices). Offers line strips, zig-zag, spiral, triangles, quads, and more connectivity patterns unique to this operator.

operators.label: Convert POP

params.label: Convert
menu: Triangle, Quads and Lines to Line Strips
Reverse Vertex Order of Each Primitive
Unique and Reorder Points by Prim/Vertex Order

operators.description: Reconnects points as different primitive types. Converts between line strips, lines, triangles, quads. Can close/open line strips, reverse vertex order, and flatten geometry.

operators.label: Copy POP
operators.description: Makes copies of input geometry using either a count parameter or a template POP. Copies are placed at template point positions with cumulative transforms. Supports look-at, up vector, and per-copy attribute combinations.

operators.label: CPlusPlus POP
Curve POP
operators.description: GPU-accelerated NURBS/Bezier curve generator. Evaluates curves from control points on the GPU with configurable order, tension, and weight. Supports open or closed curves for motion paths and parametric shapes.

operators.label: DAT to POP
Delete POP
operators.description: Removes or keeps points/primitives using 5 methods: Attribute (value comparison), Thin (index range/random), Pattern (index matching), Group (group membership), Bounding (spatial volumes). Methods combine with AND/OR/XOR logic.

operators.label: Dimension POP
DMX Fixture POP
DMX Out POP
Extrude POP

params.key: Copy Topology Info Back to CPU
params.label: Copy Topology Info Back to CPU

operators.description: Extrudes point or line primitives along normals or a direction vector. New in 2025.3: Supports line strip extrusion.

operators.label: Facet POP
operators.description: Controls point sharing between primitives. Unique Points splits shared points, Consolidate Points merges nearby points, Cusp Polygons splits at sharp edges. Essential for controlling shading and geometry topology.

operators.label: Feedback POP
Field POP
File In POP
operators.description: Reads a file and converts it into a POP in GPU memory. Supports OBJ (faces, line strips, UV, normals, RGB), PLY (polygons, vertex colors), TOG (TD native), BHClassic/HClassic (Houdini). HTTP URLs supported.

operators.label: File Out POP
operators.description: Writes POP contents to file types including OBJ (normals, UV, color), SPZ (Gaussian splatting), E57 (point clouds), PLY (arbitrary attributes), EXR (arbitrary attributes). Supports single file or file sequence recording.

operators.label: Force Radial POP
GLSL Advanced POP

params.label: Copy Previous Pass Output to Input

operators.description: Advanced GLSL compute shader POP. Can read/write/create all attribute classes (point, vertex, primitive) simultaneously. Supports Extra Outputs for multi-POP destinations, topology modification (point/primitive counts), Per Primitive Batch mode, and full index buffer control.

operators.label: GLSL Copy POP
operators.description: Makes copies of input geometry and applies custom GLSL code to each copy. One compute shader per element type (points, vertices, primitives). Template input (second input) determines copy count and placement. Supports POP Buffers for accessing other POP data.

operators.label: GLSL Create POP
operators.description: DEPRECATED — Use GLSL Advanced POP with Topology POP instead. Was used to create geometry from scratch via compute shaders with primitive type selection (Triangles, Quads, Lines, Points). Will be removed in future versions.

operators.label: GLSL POP

params.label: Copy Previous Pass Output to Input

operators.description: Modifies input attributes with GLSL compute shaders. Works on a single attribute class (Points, Verts, or Primitives) at a time. Attributes stored as SSBOs for GPU processing. Supports multi-pass, create attributes, uniform vectors/colors/samplers, simplex noise, and hardware raytracing via Collision POP.

operators.label: GLSL Select POP
operators.description: Selects one of the Extra Output POPs from a GLSL Advanced POP. Routes the selected extra output to the main output. Simple routing operator for multi-output GLSL pipelines.

operators.label: Grid POP
operators.description: Creates rows and columns of points in a plane, optionally with slices for 3D grids. Outputs dimension metadata (_Dim[]) for downstream operators. Supports connectivity options (lines, quads, triangles, line strips) and randomization for organic layouts.

operators.label: Group POP
operators.description: Creates named groups of points or primitives using 5 methods (Attribute, Thin, Pattern, Group, Bounding). Groups can then be used in other POPs to affect only specific elements. Edit page supports rename, convert, delete.

operators.label: Histogram POP
operators.description: Creates a frequency distribution of attribute values. Divides value range into N bins and counts how many points fall into each bin. Output has N points with Count attribute. Useful for data analysis and visualization.

operators.label: Import Select POP
In POP
Limit POP
operators.description: Clamps, loops, or zig-zags attribute values within a range. Supports per-component control via Parameter Size. Can make values positive only and cast to integer. Built-in quantization (Floor/Round/Ceiling). Works on point, vertex, or primitive attributes.

operators.label: Line Break POP
Line Divide POP
Line Metrics POP
Line POP
operators.description: GPU-accelerated line strip generator. Creates straight line geometry with configurable divisions, length, and axis orientation. Foundation for linear arrays, laser scans, and spline subdivision inputs.

operators.label: Line Resample POP
operators.description: Resamples line strips using 4 methods: Divisions per Line Strip, Distance between Points, By Curvature (adaptive), and Points as Keyframes (independent variable). Supports ControlPoints attribute to force resampled curve through exact control points. Does not change line shape (unlike Line Smooth POP).

operators.label: Line Smooth POP
Lookup Attribute POP
operators.description: Takes an attribute (Lookup Index Attribute) with values in the 0-1 range and uses it as an index into attributes of a second input (the lookup curve). Outputs looked-up values into new or existing attributes. The lookup curve (second input) can be a Curve POP.

operators.label: Lookup Channel POP
operators.description: Takes an attribute (Lookup Attribute) with values in the 0-1 range and uses it as an index into the channels of a CHOP, pulling one interpolated value per channel and placing those values into POP attributes.

operators.label: Lookup Texture POP
operators.description: Takes two attributes (Lookup Attribute U and V) with values in the 0-1 range and uses them as pixel coordinates into a TOP, pulling RGBA values and placing them into POP attributes. Supports 3D textures via the W attribute.

operators.label: Math Combine POP
Math Mix POP
operators.description: Multi-step attribute math operator with sequential blocks. Each block operates on 1-3 attributes using 70+ operations (A+B, sin(A), mix(A,B,C), etc.). Supports multiple inputs with auto-naming (in1_, in2_ prefixes), built-in attributes (_ prefixed), and generates GLSL code viewable via Info DAT.

operators.label: Math POP
operators.description: Single-attribute math operator with Pre Operation → Pre Add → Multiply → Post Add → Post Operation pipeline. Supports Parameter Size 1-4 for per-component control. Includes built-in ReRange and Quantize. Generates GLSL-compatible operations.

operators.label: Merge POP
operators.description: Merges points, vertices, and primitives from all inputs into one output. Output count = sum of all input counts. Preserves groups and combined attributes. Supports per-input group filtering with unique group names.

operators.label: Neighbor POP
operators.description: Finds neighboring points/primitives for each element. New in 2025.3: Works with all primitive types in Connected mode.

operators.label: Noise POP
operators.description: Applies noise fields (Perlin/Simplex 2D-4D) to point positions and attributes. Outputs raw noise, gradient (rate-of-change), and curl (twist) attributes. Supports per-point parameter mapping for spatially varying noise.

operators.label: Normalize POP
operators.description: Normalizes any attribute to 0-1 range. Supports polar/cylindrical coordinate conversion (radius, latitude, longitude). Post-normalization pipeline: Bias → Lookup Curve → Exponent → Re-range. Handles inf/nan with Replace Errors. Per-component control via Parameter Size.

operators.label: Normal POP

params.label: Normals Action
menu: Compute if it does not exist

params.label: Tangents Action
menu: Compute if it does not exist

operators.description: Creates normal and tangent vectors from triangle/quad geometry. Computes point or vertex normals with weighting methods (Average, Angle Weighted, Area Weighted). Tangents computed from texture coordinates for normal mapping.

operators.label: Null POP
OAK Select POP
Out POP
Particle POP
operators.description: POP for particle lifecycle management with Euler integration. New in 2025.3: Jitter Birth Position, Jitter Births During Frame, Pre-Roll, and Death Attribute parameters.

operators.label: Pattern POP
operators.description: Generator that creates line strip shapes or modifies attributes using elementary math functions (sine, cosine, triangle, square, ease in/out, random). Supports Parameter Size 1-4 for per-component curves, cyclic mode, line breaks per cycle, and texture coordinate generation.

operators.label: Phaser POP
operators.description: Staggered (time-offset) animation interpolation on POP attributes. Each point animates from 0 to 1 over a cycle, but arrives at different times based on an input attribute. Creates a Phaser attribute for wave interference and staggered timing effects. Supports smoothstep easing and extend modes (clamp, cycle, mirror).

operators.label: Plane POP
operators.description: Creates rows and columns of points in a planar grid shape with various connectivity options (triangles, quads, lines, line strips). Outputs dimension metadata (_Dim[]) for downstream POPs. Supports anchor, transform, normal, and texture coordinate generation.

operators.label: Points, Vertices and Primitives in POPs
operators.description: Conceptual reference page explaining the fundamental data structure of POPs: Points (positions + attributes), Vertices (indices connecting points to primitives), and Primitives (polygons, lines, points). Not an operator — educational reference for understanding POP data architecture.

operators.label: Point File In POP
Point Generator POP
operators.description: Creates a specified number of points randomly or in a pattern on the surface or within the volume of a mathematical shape (Sphere, Box, Torus, Tube, Rectangle, Circle, Line). Supports normal and tangent attributes with randomization.

operators.label: Point POP
Polygonize POP

params.label: Copy Topology Info Back to CPU

operators.description: Creates 3D polygonal surfaces enclosing pixels/points exceeding a threshold. Works with 3D textures (Texture 3D TOP) or 3D POP grids using marching cubes algorithm. In TD 2025.3, only accepts 3D input — use Trace POP for 2D. Supports ReRange P for position remapping.

operators.label: Primitive POP
operators.description: Generates and manipulates primitive-level data including points, vertices, polygons, and custom attributes. Supports creating basic shapes (sphere, box, torus, plane, etc.), subdividing primitives, converting between types, and applying transformations at the primitive level.

operators.label: Projection POP
Proximity POP
operators.description: Connects nearby points with lines within a distance range. Single input = self-connection. Two inputs = cross-connection. Outputs line primitives or point primitives with matched point attributes.

operators.label: Quantize POP
operators.description: Quantizes attribute values to discrete levels using Floor, Round, or Ceiling. Supports logical comparisons (>, >=, ==, !=, <=, <) for boolean output. Per-component control via Parameter Size. Can cast output to integer types. Works on point, vertex, or primitive attributes.

operators.label: Random POP
operators.description: Generates random attribute values with 11 distribution types (Uniform, Gaussian, Direction, Inside Sphere, etc.). Can create new attributes or modify existing ones. Supports per-point parameter mapping via Map page.

operators.label: Ray POP
operators.description: Casts rays from input points in a defined direction and reports hit information against collision geometry (second input). Supports hardware ray tracing, multiple bounces, interior/exterior detection, and barycentric coordinates.

operators.label: Rectangle POP
operators.description: Creates a 4-point rectangle with optional rounded corners. Outputs as line strip, triangles, quad, lines, point primitives, or no primitives. Supports Fill Camera View mode for camera-aligned backgrounds and input bounding box modification.

operators.label: ReRange POP
Revolve POP
operators.description: Generates a surface of revolution from any set of line strips. Points are swept around a chosen axis (Auto, X, Y, Z) to create a mesh. Each line strip generates its own surface. Supports quads, triangles, line strips, and point connectivity.

operators.label: Select POP
operators.description: Takes individual attributes from its input and outputs them unchanged. Used to work on attributes separately then combine back with Attribute Combine POP. No data copy — GPU memory consumed is 0 (reference only). Does not change point count, data, or topology.

operators.label: Skin Deform POP

params.label: Mode
menu: Skin Deform Attribute Scope as Position
Skin Deform Attribute Scope as Vector

operators.description: Deforms geometry based on skeleton transforms with per-point bone weights (skinning). Supports CPU and GPU deformation with bone groups. Works with FBX, COLLADA, and custom skeleton data.

operators.label: Skin POP
operators.description: Takes any 2-dimensional arrangement of data (e.g., multiple line strips) and connects them as a mesh of triangles or quads. Uses POP Dimension to determine point layout — skims first two dimensions and repeats for higher dimensions. Supports group-based skinning and skip-every-Nth modes.

operators.label: SOP to POP
operators.description: Converts SOP 3D geometry to POP geometry across the CPU→GPU boundary. Transfers point/vertex/primitive attributes with automatic renaming (uv→Tex, Cd→Color, width→LineWidth, pscale→PointScale). Handles triangles, quads, meshes, and NURBS with configurable conversion menus for 5+ point polygons and mesh topology.

operators.label: Sort POP
operators.description: Sorts point and/or primitive lists based on position P or any attribute. Supports sorting by proximity to point, along vector, relative to Geometry COMP Z-axis, randomizing, or circular shifting. Uses FidelityFX Parallel Sort (GPU-accelerated).

operators.label: Sphere POP
operators.description: Creates spherical shapes in Geodesic (equally-spaced triangles), Grid (latitude/longitude), Tetrahedron, or Shared Points at Poles modes. Supports ellipsoid radii, partial spheres, fish-eye/equirectangular texture mapping.

operators.label: Sprinkle POP
Subdivide POP
Switch POP
operators.description: Switches between input POPs based on index parameter. Supports fractional index blending between adjacent inputs (when same point count). Extend modes: Clamp, Loop, ZigZag. Length Mismatch handling and per-component attribute scope for blending.

operators.label: Texture Map POP
operators.description: Creates Tex attribute for applying texture maps to surfaces. Supports multiple projection methods: XYZ, Cylindrical, Face, Equirectangular (VR), Equidistant Azimuth (dome), Perspective (projection mapping), and Triplanar.

operators.label: Text POP
operators.description: New in TD 2025.3: Generates text as 3D line strips and triangles. Combines functionality of Text SOP, Text COMP, and Geo Text COMP into the high-speed POP environment. Outputs 3D geometry that can be further processed with the full POP pipeline.

operators.label: Topology POP
operators.description: Fine control over point/vertex/primitive topology and memory allocation. Essential for combining GPU-created data buffers into proper geometry.

operators.label: TOP to POP
operators.description: Converts TOP pixel data to POP points. Supports 6 interpretation modes: Color (RGBA), Position and Active (RGB+alpha), Position (RGB), Depth (camera unprojection with FOFocal/Optical Center), Height (displacement with scale), and Custom. Depth page enables accurate 3D reconstruction from depth cameras. Multiple TOPs can be chained for multi-attribute point clouds.

operators.label: Torus POP
operators.description: GPU-accelerated torus (donut) geometry generator. Creates ring-shaped surfaces with configurable major/minor radii and tubular/radial divisions. Ideal for fusion rings, orbital emitters, and toroidal fields.

operators.label: Trace POP
operators.description: New in TD 2025.3: Traces 2D inputs (images, textures, TOPs) into line strip geometry. Derived from Polygonize POP but specialized for 2D tracing. Replaces the 2D functionality that was removed from Polygonize POP. Optimized for outputting line strips for laser, LED, and vector workflows.

operators.label: Trail POP
Transform POP
operators.description: Applies translate, rotate, and scale to P and N attributes. Supports per-point transforms via Map page, look-at orientation, 4x4 matrix input, and align operations for bounding box alignment.

operators.label: Triangulate POP
operators.description: New in TD 2025.3: Triangulates closed line strips into surface geometry made of triangles. Two modes: Convex only (highly parallel, fast) and Convex and Concave (slower but handles complex shapes). Primarily used to surface the output of Trace POP or other line-strip generators.

operators.label: Trig POP
operators.description: Converts angle attributes to/from trigonometric representations. Supports sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan, atan2, sinh, cosh, tanh with configurable angle units (degrees, radians, cycles).

operators.label: Tube POP
operators.description: GPU-accelerated tube/cylinder geometry generator. Creates configurable cylinders with independent top/bottom radii for cones, pipes, and light beams. Supports optional caps and height divisions.

operators.label: Twist POP
operators.description: Performs non-linear deformations: Twist, Bend, Shear, Taper, Linear Taper, and Squash & Stretch. Uses primary/secondary axes and pivot point. Strength and Rolloff control deformation amount and falloff. Weight attribute allows per-point control.

operators.label: ZED POP
operators.description: Uses ZED StereoLabs SDK to scan and create geometry meshes or point clouds from depth camera data. Supports live spatial mapping with mesh reconstruction, filtering, and normals. Windows only. Requires ZED TOP for input data.
